tasks.label: compile and run (PowerShell)
tasks.command: javac -cp . ${file}; Get-Content input.txt | java -cp . ${file} | Out-File -Encoding utf8 output.txt

tasks.label: compile and run with package (PowerShell)
tasks.command: javac -cp . ${file}; Get-Content input.txt | java -cp . ${input:packageName}.${file} | Out-File -Encoding utf8 output.txt
